svg.title: Azure AI Observatory architecture at a glance
svg.desc: A logical Azure architecture with five numbered flows. Existing Foundry agents and applications use app-configured OpenTelemetry instrumentation and an exporter to send traces to Application Insights and Log Analytics. Evaluation events are optional. No OpenTelemetry Collector is deployed. Azure OpenAI and PTU metrics come directly from Azure Monitor. Azure Resource Graph supplies RBAC-filtered inventory of accounts, projects and ML workspaces. Azure Managed Grafana queries these sources using its managed identity. Billed cost is optional and is not deployed by default. When enabled in flow 4, the Grafana Infinity data source queries the Cost Management Query API live, using a service principal and a client secret stored in Grafana, so it is not secretless and copies nothing to Log Analytics. Azure Monitor alerts and an optional account-filtered budget notify an action group. An optional Grafana-managed alert rule fires when the Infinity data source cannot query Cost Management, for example because its secret failed. It notifies a Grafana contact point that the user creates, not the action group, and it is not an advance expiry warning. Terraform or Bicep deploys the observability resources; existing AI accounts are not created or resized. The tenant outline is logical, not a network boundary or live resource inventory.
svg.text: Azure AI Observatory — architecture at a glance
Agent telemetry, native metrics and optional costs converge in Grafana.
CUSTOMER AZURE TENANT • LOGICAL VIEW, NOT A NETWORK BOUNDARY
AI resources can span subscriptions; the optional cost query reads one scope. The starter uses public endpoints.
Managed identity queries permitted data sources
• Cost visibility (optional, direct query via Infinity)
Business overview: agent and PTU metrics, no cost data.
Entra authentication; Grafana Admin / Viewer roles
Viewer access is not a data-isolation boundary.
Scope identity access and workspace data.
Live billed cost, queried from Grafana through the Infinity data source
Client secret stored in Grafana; rotate it.
Live query; nothing is copied to Log Analytics.
Actual pretax cost; not invoice totals.
Billing can lag; the Query API can throttle.

g.text: Agent rules query the monitoring workspace.
Threshold notification, not a spending cap
GRAFANA-MANAGED ALERTING • SEPARATE FROM AZURE MONITOR ALERTS AND THE ACTION GROUP
Fires when the secret or the query fails
After two failed checks; not an expiry warning
Optional; needs the Infinity cost path.
You create it and a policy
Separate from the Azure action group.
Deploy with Terraform or Bicep; existing AI accounts and deployments are monitored, not created or resized.
Managed identities use scoped roles; the optional Infinity cost path uses a client secret. Viewer is not data isolation; the starter uses public endpoints, not private networking.
